subject.title: Telegram: apiRoot local Bot API server receives updates but never dispatches to agent sessions

question: Should Telegram local Bot API endpoint changes reset/scope polling offsets, and should startup tolerate `400: Logged out` only during the local-server migration window?
rationale: The source fix is clear enough to be bounded, but the default policy affects upgrade behavior, startup failure semantics, and whether OpenClaw hides or surfaces Telegram control-plane errors.

options.title: Endpoint-aware migration path
options.body: Scope or reset offsets when the normalized `apiRoot` changes, tolerate only the documented local-server `Logged out` migration state, and require live local Bot API proof.

options.title: Docs-only manual reset
options.body: Document that operators must clear Telegram offsets during local Bot API migration and keep strict startup failure handling.

options.title: Strict startup behavior
options.body: Keep current offset/token identity and fail closed on all non-network `deleteWebhook` errors, accepting that local migration remains manual and fragile.

recommendation.title: Endpoint-aware migration path
recommendation.body: Scope or reset offsets when the normalized `apiRoot` changes, tolerate only the documented local-server `Logged out` migration state, and require live local Bot API proof.
